MU.name: memory_storage_public_cohort
MU.rationale: Public NAND and storage vendors provide a cycle-sensitive valuation reference when the provider peer endpoint returns broad technology companies.
limitations: No listed pure-play US DRAM/HBM peer exists.
Storage mix and capital intensity differ from Micron.
TTM P/E is pro-cyclical and can overstate value near a memory-cycle peak.
The cohort may extend a valuation range but cannot replace the primary DCF.
